timing: Specified during evaluation, before reading final evaluation outcomes
primary_population: 240 dates requested by the user, with explicit unlimited official interpolation
primary_mean: Average each metric over 32 paired noise seeds per date, then average dates equally; do not simulate an averaged PV day
independent_confirmation: 192 dates excluded from LYA parameter tuning, with evaluation noise seeds distinct from tuning seeds
quality_sensitivity: Report the same frozen policies and scales on the 195 dates complete at 300s gap limit, the 213 dates complete at 600s limit and the 142 recommended dense dates
uncertainty_amendment: Use 2000 paired calendar-week cluster bootstrap replicates as the reported interval, rather than treating all weather days or epoch observations as independent. Resample weeks jointly across policies; within each replicate retain equal date weights.
interpretation: Intervals describe finite recorded-weather variability conditional on the frozen simulator, selected parameters and interpolation assumption; they do not include MLP calibration uncertainty or unknown weather within long gaps.
parameter_selection: With weights fixed to [100,10,1], select smallest equal-date mean TARS among V candidates with DWAE <=0.24 in every tuning run; ties within 1e-10 W choose smaller V.
original_policy_control: LYA-fixed retains original selected fixed-weight LYA; not included among the six baselines or the seven main plotted algorithms.
revision_scope: Change the LYA schedule by request; retain the original statistical procedure and all date subsets.
